headlines.title: Accenture (ACN): Record Managed Services Contracts Meet a Tougher Regulatory Backdrop
headlines.summary: We recently shared our list of the 10 Best Stocks to Buy After Democrats’ Election Sweep, According to CIBC, with Accenture (NYSE:ACN) ranking 10th on it. CIBC Capital Markets recommended a list of top stock picks after the Democratic sweep of Congress, according to CNBC, citing a potentially tougher regulatory environment for corporate America.

headlines.title: Accenture (ACN) Lands 850 Role Outsourcing Mandate In Major IT And AI Overhaul
headlines.summary: Accenture (NYSE:ACN) has been selected by Qantas to take on 850 outsourced head office roles in a major technology revamp. The mandate covers a large scale overhaul of Qantas legacy IT systems alongside a broad artificial intelligence transformation program. The outsourcing move shifts a sizable portion of Qantas in house technology and support work into Accenture managed services and consulting teams.

headlines.title: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish on Accenture Stock?
headlines.summary: Although Accenture has lagged behind the broader market over the past year, Wall Street analysts maintain a moderately optimistic outlook about the stock’s prospects.

description: Accenture plc provides consulting and managed services in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. It offers artificial intelligence and data; cloud consulting; cybersecurity consulting; digital engineering and manufacturing; ecosystem partners; emerging technology; finance and risk management consulting; infrastructure and capital projects; digital learning; supply chain consulting; technology consulting; sustainability consulting; and metaverse solutions, as well as customer services. The company also provides proprietary assets and platforms, such as GenWizard, SynOps and reinvention.AI to clients. It serves aerospace and defense, automotive, banking, capital markets, chemicals, communications and media, consumer goods and services, energy, health, high tech, industrial, insurance, life sciences, natural resources, private equity, public service, retail, software and platforms, travel, and utilities industries. Accenture plc was founded in 1951 and is based in Dublin, Ireland.
